title: [GMCP 203.013.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: MRTR, elicitation, sampling, and roots interaction model
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-013-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: The model-request/tool-response flow fully implements input_required, typed inputRequests, retry with inputResponses, nested elicitation, sampling and roots compatibility, cancellation, deadlines, progress, partial failure, and explicit handle ownership. Every human or model decision is attributable, policy-checked and resumable, and replays cannot duplicate side effects or hijack another principal's handle. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
